description.text: The first enhanced expansion pack of the Sun & Moon series, released on 27 January 2017 to strengthen decks built from Collection Sun, Collection Moon and the three Starter Sets. Every card is holo, and each pack held five, one of them a basic Energy, so a deck of holo cards alone was possible. Alongside some cards from the first expansions it brought new Pokémon-GX such as Sylveon-GX, Toxapex-GX, Drampa-GX and Vikavolt-GX. The cards are numbered to 51, followed by full-art Super Rare and rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, gold Ultra Rare Rare Candy, Double Colorless Energy and Grass Energy, and the holo basic Energy.
